Prepare d-curves for hypothesis testing

Source: R/MiSA_test.R
MiSA_data.Rd

Prepares \(d\)-curves for downstream hypothesis testing by filtering out images with limited spatial range and truncating the remaining curves to a common maximum radius.

Usage

MiSA_data(est_d, r_thresh = NULL)

Arguments

est_d

A list of estimated \(d\)-curves and group labels for each taxon and image, as returned by estimate_d.

r_thresh

(optional) Numeric value giving the radius threshold used to filter out images with limited spatial range. Images whose \(d\)-curve does not have valid values up to r_thresh are excluded from further analysis. Defaults to NULL, in which case images whose \(d\)-curve does not reach 0.5 times the maximum radius considered while estimating \(d\)-curve. Users may set r_thresh based on the scientific question of interest; for example, r_thresh = 500 will exclude \(d\)-curves that do not have valid estimates up to \(r = 500\).

Value

A list of filtered and truncated \(d\)-curves, ready for input into downstream hypothesis testing functions.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data_pre <- MiSA_data(est_d)
data_pre <- MiSA_data(est_d, r_thresh = 500)
} # }
